_why: Role track for the INDUSTRIAL ELECTRICIAN, authored under docs/profiling/role-pack-authoring-guide.md as Batch 2 part two. fam_electrical (the domestic wireman, ISCO unit 7411) and fam_electrical_equipment (the generic ISCO-minor-741 interview) stay exactly as they are and are NOT touched; this pack belongs to fam_industrial_electrician, which binds jd_nco_7412_0200 'Electrical Fitter' directly (job_domain specificity 50 beats minor 30). That is the code the 2026-09-24 alias tranche (#1685) put 'panel wiring', 'industrial electrician', 'panel electrician' and 'plant electrician' on, so a plant electrician gets panel-and-drive depth and every other worker under 741 keeps the interview they have today. Owner ruling A2 keeps the generic electrician vocabulary on the domestic wireman; no 7411 code is bound here.
_scope: MCC/PCC PANELS, VFD AND AC DRIVES, STARTERS, INDUCTION MOTORS AND LT DISTRIBUTION on a running plant -- panel wiring, drive parameter setting, fault finding, cable termination and earthing. The level ladder (Helper / Electrician / Senior) is asked as electrician_level so the sheet can say which rung the man stands on. House wiring belongs to fam_electrical, overhead lines and cable jointing to fam_lineman, and motor winding to the armature winder's own code; none of them is bound here.
_depth: THE TIER GATE IS electrical_experience, asked FIRST, and it is INDUSTRIAL_ELECTRICIAN.tenureQuestionKey. It cannot be experience_years from qp_universal: phase order runs occupation_specific BEFORE universal_tail, so the universal answer does not exist yet when these items are selected -- gating on it is permanently false. Its options carry value_number ONLY. pack-registry.service.ts resolves valueText ?? valueNumber, so a value_text beside the number would turn every gte gate below into a string comparison that is false forever.
_budget: MAX_ENGINE_ASKS is 48 and qp_universal@4 spends at most 18. Tier 0 is 7 items, tier 1 (electrical_experience >= 2) adds 3, tier 2 (>= 5) adds 3 -- a senior walks 13, two fewer than the welder's 15, so the worst case is 13 + 18 = 31 against 48. The three fresher items are gated electrical_experience <= 0, so a senior never sees them and a fresher, who fails both gte gates by construction, tops out at 7 + 3 = 10.
_sheet: SECTION B IS READ OFF THE RATIFIED INDUSTRIAL ELECTRICIAN REFERENCE RESUME (Balwant Singh, page 9), not invented. Its eight rows are Work type, Equipment, Panel & motor work, Instruments, Voltage worked on, Drawings, Licence and Sector worked, and every one has a question here that fills it. Panel & motor work carries SIX values plus the escape because the page prints six. Voltage worked on is a multi_select because the page prints two clauses ('LT up to 415 V · HT switchyard exposure under supervision') and the default ' · ' join reproduces them. The Licence cell is HALF-CAPTURED: this pack stores the licence TYPE and prints 'Electrician licence'; the page's '· Uttar Pradesh, valid to 2028' is an issuing state and an expiry year no question here stores -- a known capture gap, stated here because nothing prints it. The page prints 'Clamp meter' and 'Tong tester' as two instruments; both chips are kept because the page keeps both. This pack has no case in role-sheet-parity.render.test.ts yet.
_keys: NO DIGITS IN ANY question_key OR option_key. Both regexes are ^[a-z_]+$, and slugKey REFUSES a key with a digit at runtime even where the corpus validator historically let it through -- one such key makes the whole pack unparseable. measuring_tools, drawing_reading and sector_worked are the SHARED keys other packs already use, deliberately: resume-degradation.ts sheds rows BY KEY (sector_worked first) to keep a sheet on one page, and a private key would opt this trade out of that. The voltage and licence rows are NOT qp_electrical's voltage_level / licence_held: those carry a different option vocabulary (and licence_held is a boolean), so sharing the key would carry a domestic answer into this sheet as a slug no dictionary knows. electrical_work_type is not qp_universal's work_types, which is a different fact.
review_note: Drafted for owner review. Shop-floor vocabulary NOT yet corrected by a practising industrial electrician -- see docs/registers/trade-content-ratification.md.
_fresher: Guideline section 11 #1: a fresher's Zone 4 is training, trade test, machines used in the ITI workshop and project work, and the History heading never renders empty. These three items are the ask half; resume-fresher-rows.ts, fed by this role's descriptor, is the render half. The KEYS are read literally by that file and must not be renamed; only the workshop VOCABULARY is trade-specific, and an ITI Electrician's workshop holds wiring boards, starters and motor-generator sets, not the plant's MCC. The three prompts are the welder's verbatim, so they reuse its served text and its voice clips.

items.prompt_text: Aap kis tarah ka bijli kaam karte hain?
